description: What the user's Replo plan includes in Sightglass: the plan name, row caps per list, whether sales and traffic estimates are included, the history and trend windows, and how many new-brand researches are used and left this month. Call it when a result comes back with locked fields and the user asks why, or before sightglass_research_company.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects: where the charge or the asset lands. Its workspace's plan applies.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Sets which workspace's plan applies; required when the user has more than one workspace.
